status_note: status maps each part of an entry to a tag; an entry can carry more than one; weld is a list of 2+ measurands; context_any (optional) limits a hit to sentences holding one of its words; source_check PENDING marks sources not yet located

weld: origin funding (who paid for the first working version)
civilian scale-up phase (who made it widely usable)
entries.dropped: peacetime scale-up: GPS civil use opened 1983, selective availability turned off 2000; internet commercial phase 1991-95
entries.check_question: Which phase does the example come from: origin funding or civilian scale-up?
entries.example_case: GPS: military origin, civil access 1983, full civil accuracy 2000

weld: legal declaration
operational hostilities
mobilization
entries.dropped: which of the three the speaker means; they move independently
entries.check_question: Which of the three: legal declaration, operational hostilities, or mobilization?
entries.example_case: operational hostilities without a legal declaration

weld: substrate sense (the being, its body and its couplings)
economic task sense (one paid task output)
entries.dropped: every axis other than the task measured
entries.scope_tested: task output on a defined benchmark
entries.check_question: Replace on which axis? Does the same claim hold for goldenrod or feldspar?
entries.example_case: a task benchmark read as a statement about the worker

weld: reported stock
usable stock above the operating floor (pipeline fill, tank bottoms, working minimum)
entries.example_case: US distillate 99.3 M bbl reported (EIA WPSR week ending 2026-10-30); roughly 8-15 days above floor

weld: U1 national crude-unit ratio, idle units in denominator
U2 running-plant ratio
U3 bottleneck-unit load
entries.check_question: Which denominator: operable capacity, running plants, or the bottleneck unit?
entries.example_case: U1 92.8% week ending 2026-10-23 while a bottleneck unit can be pinned

weld: reallocation of existing barrels
new barrels
entries.dropped: who can burn it: 500 ppm fuel is usable only by pre-2007 and Tier 1-3 engines
entries.example_case: 500 ppm diesel waiver against a post-2007 fleet
sources: https://www.epa.gov/system/files/documents/2026-10/fuel-waiver-txled-ulsd-2026-1020.pdf (EPA letter to Texas, 2026-10-20; 500 ppm for engines certified on < 500 ppm; DPF / catalyst and Tier 4 nonroad excluded)

weld: diesel (indexed in surcharge formulas)
DEF and other operating inputs (unindexed)
entries.example_case: surcharge indexed to diesel while DEF is paid by the operator

weld: civilian base as a source
civilian base as a dependency that degrades under the same draw
entries.scope_tested: Sep 30 2026 founding memo (read via vendor reprint; defense.gov PDF unreachable from the reading session) and Oct 6 2026 implementation memo as reported. 90-day figure is from Fox-reported documents, not memo text.
entries.check_question: Was co-deterioration of the civilian base modeled?
entries.example_case: FORTRESS memo text has no civilian term

weld: price under competing providers, access and working transactions
price where those preconditions are absent
entries.check_question: Are the preconditions met: competing providers, access, working transactions?
entries.example_case: a price quoted where only one provider can deliver

weld: standing (has not failed so far)
load rating (computed capacity against the loads it will see)
entries.dropped: the load computation; prevention work is uncounted
entries.example_case: a structure standing because its design load has not yet arrived

weld: biological selection (removal from a population over generations)
AI or market change (four cuts: non-exclusive, authored environment, no stable base, per-instance judge)
entries.check_question: Was anything removed from the population?
entries.example_case: model versions described as evolving while older versions keep running

weld: stock on hand for N days
recovery or resupply arriving inside N
entries.example_case: a 30-day window with no named resupply path

entries.claim_as_found: past event shows the break point
weld: observed signal value (date and source)
censored threshold (the response fired before the break)
entries.scope_tested: the stress signal, not the failure
entries.example_case: Australia AdBlue Dec 2021; US PADD 1 diesel Oct 2022: response fired first in both

weld: a date
a snapshot of the conditions when the date was set
entries.scope_tested: conditions at the time the date was set
entries.check_question: Which milestones stand behind the date?
